summary.text: John Boozman was first elected to the U.S. Senate in 2010 and sworn in for a third term on January 3, 2023; he chairs the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition and Forestry.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate he represented Arkansas's Third District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
Raised in Fort Smith, he graduated from the Southern College of Optometry in 1977 and practiced optometry, co-founding a family eye care business with his brother.
He lives in Rogers, Arkansas, with his wife, Cathy.
